correctness.rationale: Rule a+b=n-2 for n>=2 with terminals 0,1 matches Dawson's Kayles octal .07: Grundy replay G(n)=mex{G(a)^G(n-2-a)} reproduces OEIS A002187 offset prefix (G[0..31]=0,0,1,1,2,0,3,1,1,0,3,3,2,2,4,0,5,2,2,3,3,0,1,1,3,0,2,1,1,0,4,5). L-induction: floor(a/2)+floor(b/2)<=floor((n-2)/2)=floor(n/2)-1 with equality at (0,n-2), so L(n)=floor(n/2). S-induction: inequality f(a)+f(b)>=floor((a+b)/3) checked on all 9 residue pairs, plus floor((n-2)/3)+1=floor((n+1)/3), with upper bounds via (0,n-2) when n%3!=1 and (1,n-3) when n%3==1 and n>=4, bases n=0,1,2,3 direct. Extremal/distributions follow algebraically: L=60 only at 120; S=40 exactly at 119,120; L-counts 0..59 x2 +60 x1; S-counts 0 x2,1..39 x3,40 x2. Maximal line 120->118->...->0 uses only legal splits, 60 steps. Independent replay: inputs/artifacts/verify.py prints VERIFY_OK (re-ran, exit 0), checking closed forms, full max/min agreement, extremals, both witness lines (60/40), Grundy prefix, and CSV. Result is proved, not merely experimental.

originality.rationale: Substantive gap vs nearest priors: OEIS A002187 records only Sprague-Grundy values for Dawson's Chess with FORMULA period-34 exceptions, no L/S columns; b-file to 1000 contains only bare n,a(n) Grundy pairs (live-fetched, e.g. 0 0..1000 4); live OEIS searches for 'Dawson remoteness' and 'Dawson birthday Kayles' return zero hits ('terms do not match anything'); arXiv all-fields 'Dawson's Kayles game length' returns no results; Plambeck math/0501315 is misere-quotient semigroup theory, not normal-play heap durations. Durations are not a function of Grundy numbers (standard mex vs remoteness/birthday distinction), so table cannot be transcribed or mechanically read off; different recurrence (max-plus/min-plus) and headline fact. No prior duration table found.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: shortest/longest game lengths (birthdays/remoteness, classical ONAG/Winning Ways invariants for endgame timing and solver-benchmark calibration) for flagship Dawson's Kayles heaps. Object and invariant motivated before computation (timing gap alongside settled Grundy periodicity); values floor(n/2) and floor((n+1)/3) with extremal heap 120 (60 moves), max-S 40 at 119-120, exact distributions, and per-n witnesses were not known/tabled and not mechanically implied by Grundy data; future researcher can need the precise fact. Scope 0..120 is the assigned preperiod-plus-post-cutoff window, and the uniform induction proof removes arbitrariness. This satisfies the exact-invariant clause: narrow datum but independently retrievable. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration.
